$comment: Named plugin subsets for the installers. Every marketplace plugin belongs to exactly one profile (scripts/validate.py checks this). install.sh/.ps1 (Claude Code) install every plugin unless --profile / -Profile names profiles (comma-separated, combinable with plugin names; claude-only included); they record the profiles per Claude config dir, and the SessionStart updater then installs only new plugins of those profiles (also ones moved into them here) and lists the others as available. install-copilot.sh/.ps1 default to copilotDefault. claude-only plugins rely on Claude Code features (Workflow engine, !`cmd` injection, Claude-only hook events) and are skipped by install-copilot unless named explicitly.

listingBudget.$comment: Skill-listing budgets in characters (README, Listing budget). Claude Code lists every skill and command of the installed plugins as "- plugin:name: description" lines and drops descriptions past its budget (read from 2.1.292); Copilot CLI is assumed to do the same, only its budget variable is verified. scripts/validate.py warns for each profile named here whose listing cost (SKILLS.md, Listing cost, counted the Claude Code way) is over the budget and never fails because of it; label names the client in messages and tables. A profile named under no client is not checked: add a new profile under its client. A malformed entry here is a problem (exit 1, also with --warn-only). copilot-cli: 15000 is the default of SKILL_CHAR_BUDGET (docs/ANALYSE.md copilot-cli-3, Copilot CLI 1.0.88), not re-verified. claude-code: 30000 is 1% of a 1M-token window at 3 characters per token (Claude Code 2.1.292 counts 4 for older models: 40000; a 200K window gives 6000 to 8000); skillListingBudgetFraction changes it. The installers read only profiles and copilotDefault.
